entities.summary: Salvatore Boccaccio was the "Titular" Roman Catholic bishop of Ulpiana from October 29, 1987 - April 2, 1992. He was the bishop of Sabina-Poggio Mirteto, Italy from March 17, 1992 - July 8, 1999. He was also the bishop of Frosinone-Veroli-Ferentino, Italy from July 9, 1999, until his death on October 18, 2008, at the age of 70 years.
